title.rendered: Virtual Tour of the New Sherwood High School

content.rendered:
Dear Sherwood students, families, staff, and community — we have exciting news to share with you!

As you know, after many years of planning and construction, our new Sherwood High School is finally here.  Before the pandemic, we had planned for August 29th to be the date we would hold our building dedication ceremony, and introduce our students, families, staff, and community members to the amazing building — made possible by the voters and the hard work and dedication of so many.

While we look forward to bringing our students and staff back together in this building in the future, we want to make sure you had an opportunity to see the building now — and as such, today we are excited to share with you a virtual tour video of this amazing facility!

Please click here to view the virtual tour video on our District YouTube channel.

We are grateful to our partners at Stratoscope and BRIC for helping us to bring you this incredible drone footage of Sherwood High School — and most importantly, thank you to the voters of the Sherwood community for your support of the 2016 Capital Improvement Bond that has made this opportunity possible for our entire community and most importantly, our students, for generations to come.  Enjoy!
